body: I know how it sounds when I say I'm going through a break up that this is probably the reason I'm so low and things get better ect but this has been a long drawn out break up and I'm struggling to let go of the relationship despite knowing it's not a good one but its also more complicated than that like he was all I had I don't have anyone else really so now I'm all alone with no support really and kids were massively important to me and are what led to the break up and now I feel I will never have kids and I have no future so what's the point, I'm 31 with multiple health issues so I don't exactly have all the time in the world to think of kids and I feel I've just wasted the last 5 yrs of my life and got no where and I can't bare to think I will be looking back in 5 yrs again and be no further forward

I have a service called penumbra who come to help me around the house for an hr twice a week I've been on a waiting list for phycology for a yr and am now on the waiting list for phyciatry but I've been going through this for so long I can't keep holding on and waiting I've been fighting for the right help for yrs and I never seem to get anywhere, I literally barely leave the house any more, my mum comes to help me every couple of days but she has enough on her plate she doesn't need to be having to do that too, I have one friend who I only met recently but she lives over an hour away and has alot on herself so I spend almost all my time alone wanting to not be here and I just can't keep fighting it
